root_cause: The initial Jev probe used shell heredoc syntax in PowerShell, then supplied choice criteria as a list and omitted the required label-description mapping.
actual_effect: The first probe attempt did not execute; the next two API requests returned HTTP 422 validation errors.
recovery: Moved the probe to a temporary Python file and corrected choice.criteria to a label-to-description object. The final three-candidate probe returned HTTP 200 responses.
